app.name: Scene buttons
app.summary: A light tile with keys that turn on your scenes, and a tap that switches the light on and off.
app.tile_example: Living room ceiling, with keys N, A and F
app.press_hint: A button such as input_button.living_room_on. Left empty, a tap turns the light on.
app.press_off_hint: A button that turns the light off. Left empty, a tap turns the light off.
app.scene_hint: A scene entity such as scene.living_room_normal. Left empty, the key is not shown.
